info.title: Remote Work Tracker — Portal API
info.description:
REST API for the Remote Work Tracker web portal (Express + TypeScript). Routes and Zod request/response schemas are generated from source via `npm run openapi:generate`.

### Authentication
Most endpoints require a **portal JWT** as a Bearer token. Click **Authorize** and paste your access token, then use **Try it out** on any operation. Agent (device) endpoints under `/api/v1/agent/*` use a separate **device JWT**.

### Response envelope
Successful responses use the `SuccessEnvelope` shape (`{ success, message, data }`); failures use `ErrorEnvelope` (`{ success, message, code?, errors? }`).

### Attendance / agent desk
Canonical read model is **`GET /api/v1/telemetry/agent/daily`** and **`GET /api/v1/telemetry/agent/activity-detail`** (UTC calendar days). **`GET /api/v1/attendance`** is a façade of the same aggregates for legacy clients.

### AI analytics
Paths under **`/api/v1/ai/*`** authenticate with the portal JWT, then the backend calls the **AI microservice** using service credentials. Pair this spec with the FastAPI OpenAPI at **`{AI_SERVER_URL}/docs`**.
